title: Game manifest — fields the game pack adds (foundation §1.2, §3.5)
description: Merged into packages/shared gameManifestSchema by F2. Every game (the five existing ones included) carries them. `description` stays in the manifest but is served only through `about`.

icon.description: One emoji. Bingo 🎱, Blanks 🃏, Broken Pencil ✏️, Lightning Round ⚡, Wisecrack 😂, Imposter 🕵️, Herd Mind 🐑, Fake-Out 🎭, Who Said It 🗣️, Tune In 📻, Hive Rank 🐝, Echo 🔁, Blind Auction 🔨, Spy Grid 🗂️, Nightfall 🌙

tagline.description: ≤ 60 chars in the catalog (the manifest schema allows 80 today — see FOUNDATION-AUDIT). Translatable.

howToPlay.description: Exactly three steps, each ≤ 90 chars, translatable.

addedOn.description: ISO date; drives the NEW badge (server computes isNew = within 30 days).

tags.description: 1–3 from the fixed list; `quick` = 8 minutes or less.
